claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby.

claims.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
claims.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

claims.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new HQ will give an estimated £151 million boost to the region's economy.

claims.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
claims.statement: Construction of the Becketwell HQ is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
claims.statement: The Derby site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: Great Britain Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers - with Derby at the heart of its future.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission of better services for passengers, with Derby at the heart of its future.

claims.quote: I’m particularly pleased about the 600 apprenticeship places.
claims.statement: Claire Ward is pleased about the 600 apprenticeship places.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways' headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years, 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years and 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the network.

facts.quote: The announcement builds on the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: There has been a recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north to be built at Alstom's Derby site.

facts.quote: at a time when less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham made a statement on the GBR headquarters and apprenticeships.
Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander made a statement on the GBR headquarters and apprenticeships.

facts.quote: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden said:
facts.statement: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden made a statement on the foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: Mayor of the East Midlands, Claire Ward, said:
facts.statement: Mayor of the East Midlands Claire Ward made a statement welcoming the announcement.
